name: ATM Withdrawal Completion Acknowledgement V 03
definition: The ATMWithdrawalCompletionAcknowledgement message is sent by an acquirer or its agent to an ATM to acknowledge the receipt of an ATMWithdrawalCompletionAdvice message.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

ATMWithdrawalCompletionAcknowledgement.name: ATM Withdrawal Completion Acknowledgement
ATMWithdrawalCompletionAcknowledgement.definition: Information related to the acknowledgement of an ATM withdrawal transaction from the ATM manager.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC.
